verdict.rationale: MX's Instant Account Verification retrieves account and routing numbers for demand deposit accounts through the Connect Widget and Platform API (mx-docs-15, mx-docs-21). Tokenized Account Numbers are documented as substitute numbers for secure ACH money movement (mx-docs-24). Microdeposits are described as a separate, alternate verification method, which implies instant verification works without them (mx-docs-3). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed docs on handing verified numbers or TANs to an ACH processor to fund payments.
